title: (RHEA-2017:1326) ostree enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated ostree packages are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extras.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
OSTree is a tool for managing bootable, immutable, versioned file system trees.

The ostree packages have been upgraded to upstream version 2017.5, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version. (BZ#1447077)

Users of ostree are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and adds these enhancements.
